description: California Polytechnic State University publishes this recovered water-level record for 25 sites in the Sacramento–San Joaquin Delta. It combines digitised archival daily maximum and minimum levels, including newly recovered 1915–1982 material, with later digital records through 2023. Quality checks and datum corrections put the time series on a common geocentric reference. The current Zenodo version two lists station-specific CSV and text files totalling about 55.2 MB; DataCite gives CC BY 4.0 and public access without a fee. The data can calibrate estuary boundary conditions, test flood-level simulation, or examine interactions among tides, river discharge and sea-level rise near levees. It is related to the catalogue USGS water-data APIs as another US water-observation source, but this deposit supplies corrected long historical Delta series. A caveat is that gauge periods vary, and historical ledgers contain gaps; version two also corrected additional digitisation errors. No numerical file values were checked.
